description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what did $COMPANY say about X in their SEC filings" or "find filings that mention Y". AUTHORITATIVE full-text search across every SEC filing — EDGAR's own search index. Filter by form type ("10-K" annual, "10-Q" quarterly, "8-K" current event, "DEF 14A" proxy), date range, and optionally one filer (`entity`). Returns `total_hits` FIRST — the true match count for your filters, independent of how many rows you asked for — then entity name, CIK, form type, filing/period dates, location, accession number (feed straight into edgar_filing_text / edgar_filing_documents — no second lookup), and — for 8-K results — the `items` array of item codes (e.g. "3.01" listing deficiency vs "1.01" material agreement vs "3.02" unregistered sale), which carry the actual signal. **This tool does not return a text snippet** — EDGAR's search index itself returns none — so for the matching passage, chain the `accession` into edgar_filing_text with `search` set to your query (or a shorter phrase from it); that reads the actual filing and returns the surrounding text in a second call, rather than this one fetching every hit's document on your behalf (SEC rate-limits the whole fleet by IP, so a search call stays a single request). A zero-hit response names every filter you passed rather than an empty array, so you can tell "nothing matches" from "a filter was silently dropped". Use when you need to find filings matching a topic across the whole market, not for a specific company (for that use edgar_company_filings).

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., "2024-12-31"). If you pass this without `start_date`, `start_date` is defaulted to EDGAR full-text search's coverage floor (2001-01-01) rather than silently ignored.

entity.description: Narrow results to ONE filer, by ticker ("AAPL"), company name ("Apple Inc."), or CIK ("320193") — omit to search across every filer. Aliases `ticker_or_cik` / `cik` / `ticker` are also accepted, the spellings this pack's other tools use for the same thing.

form_type.description: Filter by SEC form type (e.g., "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "DEF 14A"). Omit for all types.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-40, default 10)

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., "2024-01-01"). If you pass this without `end_date`, `end_date` is defaulted to today rather than silently ignored.

name: edgar_search_filings

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format or null

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format or null
